summary: @ornikar/slate-react-fork preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package declares a preinstall script (node setup.mjs) that automatically fires on npm install. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts it to a temporary directory, chmod +x's it, and then invokes bun against the sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB single-line JavaScript file with hex-mangled identifiers (_0x...) and a rotated string-array decoder (WV8StW shift routine) — canonical string-array-obfuscator output. The obfuscated payload is only reachable via the alternate Bun runtime downloaded at install time, bypassing the code path that a Node-based audit would evaluate. The package presents itself as a Slate/React library fork under the @ornikar scope, but the repository field points to a personal fork (github.com/CorentinAndre/slate) and the preinstall dropper and obfuscated payload are not present in upstream slate-react. Installing this package grants the publisher arbitrary code execution on the installer's machine at npm install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
